name: search
title: Search
description: Search page listing: every routable page, project, item and taxonomy term (PlatformSearchIndexBuilder) rendered as a card (title linked to the page + description cut to 100 characters), all hidden until the visitor searches. Same toolbar as the other filters: keyword search (every word must match, case and accents ignored), filters, sort and texts from the "search" toolbar in data_items_listing_toolbar.json, sort (filters_sort), results count and a Show all button. The query is kept in the URL (?q=).
